source.title: Cody Rhodes Goes Sneaker Shopping With Complex

tips.text: If your feet get wider, pick sneaker models or low-tops that fit wide, or go up a size, rather than squeezing into your old size.
tips.why: Shoes that fit are worn more and look better.

tips.text: Rotate your sneakers instead of wearing the same pair day after day.
tips.why: Rotation keeps shoes fresh and lasting longer.

tips.text: A well-made custom suit does more for your wardrobe than a rare, expensive pair of sneakers.
tips.why: Tailoring is useful far more often than a collector's shoe.
